readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.body: You can view these settings; only the {{role}} role can change them.

secret.onceBody: Copy the secret and store it somewhere safe right now. Once this window closes it can't be shown again, and you'd have to create a new one.

general.publicNameHint: This name shows in the public rating instead of the tenant name. Leave it empty if you'd rather not appear there.
general.slugHint: It's part of every console and API address (/t/{slug}), so it can't change.
general.retentionHint: Finished runs are deleted with their logs and metrics after this many days.
general.defaultKeepHint: How long a stand lives after the run when the launch doesn't say otherwise. 0s removes it right away.
general.ratingTenantHint: New runs go into the tenant rating unless you turn it off at launch.
general.ratingGlobalHint: New runs go to the public rating under the tenant's public name.
general.emailsHint: Who else gets emails about runs and suites, on top of each member's own settings. Press Enter after each address.
general.transferHint: Hand the tenant to another member and become an admin yourself.
general.transferNoMembers: You can only hand the tenant to a member, so invite someone first.
general.transferWarnTitle: You will lose the owner role
general.transferWarnBody: Only the new owner can delete the tenant or hand it on, and they must not own another tenant.
general.deleteHint: Deletes every run, test, database, provider and member. Not possible while any run is going.
general.deleteBody: Everything in the tenant goes: runs and their results, the library, providers, tokens and webhooks, and none of it comes back. Cancel any running runs first or the server will refuse.

members.ownerImmutable: The owner role changes only by handing the tenant over.
members.removeBody: Access goes right away, and their personal tokens for this tenant stop working. Their runs and records stay.
members.leaveBody: Access goes right away. To come back, ask an admin to invite you again.
members.noInvitesHint: Invite teammates by email and they get the chosen role the first time they sign in.
members.inviteHint: The invitation lasts 7 days. If the person has no account yet, the role applies on their first sign-in.
members.roleHint: You can't make someone owner here; hand the tenant over instead.

roleDesc.member: Works with the library and launches tests; can cancel only their own runs

members.messagePlaceholder: Optional note included in the e-mail
members.revokeBody: The link in the email stops working; you can send a new invitation later.
members.ownerCantLeave: The owner can't leave; hand the tenant to another member first
members.notPending: The invite is no longer pending

providers.title: Provider profiles
providers.hint: A provider holds a cloud key and where to create machines (cloud, folder, zone or region). Every run picks a provider explicitly, and only ones that passed their check can be used.
providers.emptyHint: Add a Yandex Cloud key so tests run on real machines. AWS comes later.
providers.staleHint: This data is over a minute old. It refreshes itself before a run.
providers.verifyingHint: Checking that the key works and has enough rights. It usually takes under a minute.
providers.failedHint: The check failed. Fix the key and check again.
providers.readyHint: The key is checked; you can pick this provider for runs.
providers.deleteBody: Tests and suites using this provider will need another one before they run, and the key is deleted from secret storage. You can't delete it while a run is using it.
providers.kindHint: Pick a cloud; the fields below depend on it.
providers.settingsHint: Where to create machines. It isn't secret, so it's stored as is and shown on the card.
providers.credentialsHint: The key goes straight to secret storage and can't be read back through the API. To replace it, open Edit → Replace key.
providers.schemaMissing: The form for this provider didn't load; try again later.
providers.name: Profile name
providers.nameHint: Must be unique in the tenant; it shows in the launch form and the run summary.
providers.afterCreateBody: The provider gets checked first: Stroppy Cloud tries the key and reads the cloud's quotas. In about a minute the card shows it's ready, or says what's wrong.
providers.savedReverify: Provider saved, key replaced, check under way
providers.replaceCredentialsHint: While this is off the current key stays as it is. A new key goes straight to a check.

quotas.hint: Your cloud's quotas for each provider. Before a run Stroppy Cloud checks the machines it needs against them, and refreshes the numbers if they're over a minute old.
quotas.noProviders: Quotas show up once at least one provider passes its check.
quotas.unavailableGeneric: The cloud didn't return quotas for this provider, so runs aren't checked in advance and may hit the limit in the cloud itself.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.hint: HTTPS addresses Stroppy Cloud sends run and suite events to, as Standard Webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256. A failed delivery is retried, and you can resend it by hand too.
webhooks.emptyHint: Tell your CI, chat or service when a run finishes.
webhooks.urlHint: https:// only, and it must answer 2xx within 10 seconds.
webhooks.eventsHint: Which events to send. run.stage fires on every phase change.
webhooks.secretNote: The signing secret is created with the webhook and shown once.
webhooks.secretHint: Use it to check the webhook-signature header on requests to {{url}}.
webhooks.rotateBody: The old secret stops verifying immediately, so update it on the receiver right away.
webhooks.deleteBody: {{url}} stops getting events, and the delivery history is deleted.
webhooks.deliveriesHint: Newest first. Resending sends the same payload as a new delivery.

tokens.title: Service tokens
tokens.hint: Tenant tokens for CI and scripts. They aren't tied to a person and keep working when members leave.
tokens.nameHint: Where the token is used, so it's easy to find and revoke later.
tokens.roleHint: A service token is either member (launches tests) or viewer (read-only).
tokens.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty for a token that never expires.
tokens.expiresFuture: Expiry must be in the future
tokens.emptyHint: Create a token to launch tests from CI with the stroppy-cloud CLI or the API.
tokens.revokeBody: Requests with this token start getting 401 right away.

audit.noTargetLink: The target has no page of its own

actions.admin_run_cancel: Run cancelled by a platform admin
actions.admin_tenant_delete: Tenant deleted by a platform admin

table.noPermission: Your role does not allow this action
